name: Porcuna (Spain)
description: Quartered white and dark green above and purple and white below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Porcuna (a crescent on blue and a castle on white within an inscribed bordure).
history: Municipal flag of Porcuna; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Porcuna arms — crescent on blue and castle on white within an inscribed bordure
